name: Firecrawl
description: Search, scrape, and parse public web pages with Firecrawl.

methods.label: Sign in with Firecrawl
methods.whenToUse: Use interactive Firecrawl account authorization for the full hosted MCP tool surface.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in and choose the Firecrawl team whose usage should apply. This route exposes the account-authorized tool surface; review paid jobs and action policies before execution.
warnings: Account authorization exposes Firecrawl’s broader hosted MCP surface, including job-based research tools that may use account credits.
Crawls and research jobs can use provider credits; review their tool actions and limits before execution.

methods.label: Use a Firecrawl API key
methods.whenToUse: Use a customer-created Firecrawl API key in a Bearer header for unattended or higher-limit access.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a Firecrawl API key for the intended team, then connect it with a Bearer header. The authenticated server may expose additional job tools and spend team credits.

credentialFields.label: Use a Firecrawl API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Create an API key for the intended Firecrawl team with access to the search, scrape, parse, and any job tools you intend to use. Jobs can consume credits; Paperclip cannot increase an existing key’s permissions.

methods.label: Try keyless access
methods.whenToUse: Use the rate-limited keyless public web-search route without a Firecrawl credential.
methods.guidanceMd: The keyless route currently exposes Search, Scrape, and Parse. Keep requests bounded; these calls can consume the provider’s keyless allowance.
